choose.when: UPDATE docs_sw_file SET processing_status = #{status}, processing_error = NULLIF(#{lastError}, ''), processed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('DONE', 'FAIL', 'NOT_REQUIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE object_id = #{objectId} AND file_no::text = #{fileNo} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_pdf_conversion current_job WHERE current_job.conversion_id = CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid) AND current_job.object_type = 'SW' AND current_job.object_id = #{objectId} AND current_job.file_no = #{fileNo} AND current_job.current_yn = TRUE )

UPDATE docs_sw_sub_file SET processing_status = #{status}, processing_error = NULLIF(#{lastError}, ''), processed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('DONE', 'FAIL', 'NOT_REQUIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE object_id = #{objectId} AND file_no::text = #{fileNo} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_pdf_conversion current_job WHERE current_job.conversion_id = CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid) AND current_job.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND current_job.object_id = #{objectId} AND current_job.file_no = #{fileNo} AND current_job.current_yn = TRUE )
choose.otherwise: UPDATE docs_sw_file SET processing_status = processing_status WHERE FALSE

mapper.update: UPDATE docs_sw_file target SET processing_status = CASE current_job.status_cd WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 'FAIL' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'PENDING' END, processing_error = NULLIF(current_job.last_error, ''), processed_at = CASE WHEN current_job.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED', 'FAILED') THEN current_job.completed_at ELSE NULL END FROM docs_pdf_conversion current_job WHERE current_job.object_type = 'SW' AND current_job.current_yn = TRUE AND target.object_id = current_job.object_id AND target.file_no::text = current_job.file_no AND ( target.processing_status IS DISTINCT FROM CASE current_job.status_cd WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 'FAIL' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'PENDING' END OR target.processing_error IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_job.last_error, '') OR target.processed_at IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN current_job.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED', 'FAILED') THEN current_job.completed_at ELSE NULL END )

UPDATE docs_sw_sub_file target SET processing_status = CASE current_job.status_cd WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 'FAIL' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'PENDING' END, processing_error = NULLIF(current_job.last_error, ''), processed_at = CASE WHEN current_job.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED', 'FAILED') THEN current_job.completed_at ELSE NULL END, update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM docs_pdf_conversion current_job WHERE current_job.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND current_job.current_yn = TRUE AND target.object_id = current_job.object_id AND target.file_no::text = current_job.file_no AND ( target.processing_status IS DISTINCT FROM CASE current_job.status_cd WHEN 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 'FAIL' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'PENDING' END OR target.processing_error IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(current_job.last_error, '') OR target.processed_at IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN current_job.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED', 'FAILED') THEN current_job.completed_at ELSE NULL END )
